completion_receipt_protocol.circularity_rule: No intervening canonical preimage event exists. After SCOPE_LEASE_RELEASE_RECORDED, the fixed receipt preimage is a noncanonical durable artifact whose expected close sequence/prev hash are the direct next journal coordinates. SUPERVISOR_CLOSED is derived once and appended directly.
commit: append exact derived SUPERVISOR_CLOSED directly as next canonical event; no preimage-record event
reopen and verify actual event equals derived event byte-for-byte and hash-for-hash
precompute: read and verify current canonical head after SCOPE_LEASE_RELEASE_RECORDED
canonicalize and hash receipt_preimage_v1 exactly once
derive SUPERVISOR_CLOSED payload and exact event envelope from fixed preimage hash and those direct-next coordinates
compute payload and event hashes; none feed back into preimage
atomically persist fdatasync fsync-parent and reopen-verify COMPLETION-RECEIPT-PREIMAGE.json plus derived event fixture
re-read journal head under exclusive transaction lock; require it still equals expected prior head or discard preparation and recompute before any append
publish_after_close: construct COMPLETION-RECEIPT.json with receipt_preimage_v1 fields receipt_preimage_sha256 and actual closeout_head
actual closeout_head contains close sequence close event sha256 and payload sha256
reopen rehash and verify preimage projection and actual close event
release transaction lock only after verification
completion_receipt_protocol.recovery: If only preimage artifact exists and journal head remains its expected prior head, verify and append exact derived close event. If head differs, discard/quarantine orphan preparation and recompute only if journal remains open and lifecycle permits. If close event exists, reconstruct final receipt from verified preimage and actual close event. Preimage never grants semantics or authority.

closeout_head.meaning: final canonical journal event; no append follows

semantic_reduction_head.meaning: frozen semantic prefix ending at fence

mandatory_fence.noncanonical_closeout_preparation: COMPLETION-RECEIPT-PREIMAGE.json may be persisted and fsynced by the supervisor but is not a canonical event, is not semantic authority, and does not advance the journal head.
mandatory_fence.terminal_seal_rule: TERMINAL-SEAL.json is CAS-published after TERMINAL_DECISION; TERMINAL_SEAL_RECORDED is the canonical nonsemantic closeout event binding its hash.
